reviewer: independent read-only G6 cross-repeat lineage review

findings.title: G6 validation did not enforce one task lineage across repeats and counterfactual variants
findings.evidence: Before this cycle, G3/G4 identity was checked only within each (family, CF, replicate) key. A malformed plan could therefore use different case_id values across repeats of one family/CF or different paired_set_id values across CF variants while still producing locally complete G3/G4 pairs. The design requires paired_set_id to bind the four versions of one base task and repeats to be repeated observations of that task.
findings.remediation: Require one paired_set_id per theory_family_id and one (case_id, paired_set_id) lineage per theory_family_id×cf_type across all arms and repeats. Preserve the all-planned denominator and never rewrite historical artifacts.
